tiebreakers.description: Hand with the lowest total base strength wins

endCondition.description: Game ends when 10 cards are in the discard area (12 with Extra Suits).

notes: family: hand-evaluation. Hand is 7 cards (8 with Extra Suits or Necromancer; up to 9 with Outsider cards). Enter each card's final value after bonuses, penalties, blanking and clearing. Cursed Items and Extra Suits are from the Cursed Hoard included in the Deluxe box. 2-player variant draws two cards and discards one; Chaos Realms variant not modelled. Tie after tiebreaker is not addressed in the rulebook; shared victory assumed.
